Maya - CSM: Hey team — quick sync on Beta Cohort 5 feedback and renewal-risk signals. Can we do a rapid pass on open items from last week's sessions?
Carlos (Eng): Yep, got a few reports. First: customers seeing token spikes when using the guided templates.
Rina - PM: Noted. Do we have repro steps? which template?
Carlos (Eng): Template `quick-summarize-v2` for long docs. I can repro with sample `legal_contract_long.pdf`. Getting repeated calls in the logs: `request.repeat=3` after 8s.
Maya - CSM: That matches two accounts (HelixHealth, Meridian) who flagged cost creep — flagged as renewal risk in the CRM.
Ben (Ops): I can throttle batching on Dedicated pools as a short-term mitigation. Suggest lowering max_batch_size to 8 for that model.
Rina - PM: OK can we also add a UX note to the template selector: "best for <10k chars"? Prevents folks pasting whole contracts.
Carlos (Eng): Agreed. I'll push a guard in the API layer + telemetry event `template_overflow` so we can track.
OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled: Beta cohort weekly check-in • Wed 10:00am (UTC) — /remind @channel tomorrow 10am.
Maya - CSM: Action items: 1) Carlos -> guard + event (ETA: EOD today), 2) Ben -> temporary batch cap on Dedicated (ETA: 2h), 3) Rina -> UX copy update + email to cohort (ETA: tomorrow), 4) Maya -> renewal flags in CRM + targeted enablement invites.
Rina - PM: I'll draft the email and a small how-to doc — short checklist and "when not to use" examples. Link to draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/beta/quick-templates (WIP).
Carlos (Eng): Quick note — need a list of impacted customer IDs. Maya, can you post the cohort IDs?
Maya - CSM: Posting now: cohort5_ids = ["C-7721","C-7723","C-7728"] — I'll DM the full account table.
Ben (Ops): Thumbs up. I'll apply the batch cap and monitor CPU/GPU usage. Will report back in this thread with the diff.
Maya - CSM: Thanks all. If no objections, I'll run the renewal outreach after we confirm the cap and the UX update. :thumbsup:
Carlos (Eng): No objections.
Rina - PM: :thumbsup:
Ben (Ops): :thumbsup:
